entry.name: Chrome for Testing
entry.verified: none published for Chrome for Testing (no checksums/signatures); fetched over HTTPS from storage.googleapis.com only; shared libs in ~/ibbrowsers/sysroot: CentOS 7 vault (yumdownloader --resolve, i686 multilib deps dropped) .rpms fetched from the distro repos, rpm -K OK on every package (distro GPG key in the system rpmdb), unpacked with rpm2cpio|cpio
entry.notes: driver is a wrapper that sources ~/ibbrowsers/env.sh (LD_LIBRARY_PATH -> ~/ibbrowsers/sysroot, FONTCONFIG_FILE -> ~/ibbrowsers/fonts.conf) then execs the real driver next to it. --no-sandbox is required: user.max_user_namespaces=0 and no SUID sandbox without root ('No usable sandbox!'). newest Chrome for Testing whose binary runs on glibc 2.17: 126.0.6478.182 and later need GLIBC_2.25 (tested: "/lib64/libc.so.6: version `GLIBC_2.25' not found"). 115-125 need only GLIBC_2.17.
